title: Functional analysis for quantum theory
prerequisites: M4, M6, M9a; measure theory introduced in course.
purpose: Elective: distinguish finite dimensional intuition from infinite dimensional spaces and operator theory.

blocks.deliverable: Prove completeness or give a Cauchy counterexample.
Compute an operator norm in a simple example.
Compare a pointwise and an almost everywhere statement.
Week 7 proof midterm; test convergence implications.
Prove an orthogonality or projection statement.
Apply the theorem only under its actual hypotheses.
Present domain and boundedness checks and take a proof examination.

project: Explain a spectral theorem in its stated setting and audit the domain assumptions of a sample operator.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
